remarks: Sellers are considering offers between $90,000 and $110,000. Looking for an affordable three bedroom home in the Lovejoy neighborhood where all of the major updates have already been tackled for you? Well seek no further because 117 Davey St has quite possibly everything you've been hoping for! Living room, dining room, and first floor bedrooms have hardwood floors. Remodeled kitchen includes refrigerator and gas stove/convection oven. Updated full bath. The first floor laundry area is currently under construction as a possible addition to a future primary suite - can easily be converted back to a separate room or finish what the owners have started! Could easily work as a 2 bedroom ranch. Second floor includes 3rd bedroom and loads of storage space. Major updates include: Hot water tank in 2026; HVAC and AC in 2018; Electric service 2018; and roof in 2018! Basement is full and very dry and includes all glass block windows. Front porch includes all new decking. Sale includes composter in back yard AND gas generator - brand new in the box! Showings and negotiations begin immediately, so don't wait!
